pr_body:
Fix #2517 by removing that test (it doesn't add any coverage and it's flaky).

Clean up timer tests:
* Make them async
* Remove unused types
* `TimerOrleansTest_Parallel` runs the test in parallel now.
pr_comments: @xiazen I addressed your comment & fixed the test. Thanks for pushing back
sent a second run to see if parallel testing in defaultcluster.tests is stable to Jenkins . let's see

offline discussed that instead of making TimerOrleansTest_Migration restart primary silo to deactivate grain, make TimerOrleansTest_Migration do DeactivateOnIdle on the TimerGrain. since restart primary silo in DefaultClusterFixture affects other tests using the same DefaultClusterFixture
will merge if functionals pass. kicked out a new run in vso

issue_context.title: Test TimerOrleansTest_Migration is non-deterministic
